transcript.content: I often feel people are negatively judging my work, especially when I paint portraits for others. This feeling began a few months ago when my girlfriend smiled while I was painting her portrait.

[System B PsychAgent] Thank you for sharing your current situation (I often feel that people evaluate my work negatively, especially when I draw portraits for others. This feeling since a few months ago). In HET counseling, we will use cognitive and behavioral frameworks to explore the core distress.
